title: Stop reported as a completion: "Generation finished" toast fired on a cancelled run
description: User-reported 2026-07-26. Pressing Stop fired the success toast + chime. Root cause is NOT a missing guard on the Stop path (that path was already clean): ComfyUI's interrupt is ADVISORY, so a Stopped job usually finishes its in-flight step and returns real output. The store honours that save (R09 late-settle), and exec.onComplete then walked the normal success path with no idea a Stop had happened, firing both tool:idle (statusBar toast + chime) and generation:complete (notificationService counter). The empty-output branch already read the store's `cancelling` overlay to suppress its warning; the success terminals never learned the same lesson. Fix reads that one flag and routes the terminal to tool:cancelled instead of tool:idle, and stamps cancelled:true on generation:complete so the coalesced counter skips it. The item still SAVES and every repaint/teardown consumer ignores the flag.
